population.inclusion: non-missing prompt_name, holistic_essay_score, ell_status; member of a usable (prompt, human_score) stratum (>=2 essays, both ELL categories)

sampling.method: proportional stratified (largest remainder) over the 61 usable strata; SRS without replacement within stratum; per-stratum SeedSequence(entropy=sampling_seed, spawn_key=(stratum_index,))

judge.primary: gpt-5-mini (OpenAI) -- API availability, exact snapshot id, and pricing to be verified before scoring; the verified snapshot id will be recorded here BEFORE any call

analysis.null: S independent of A given (Y, P)
analysis.score_binning: native ordinal categories; category space fixed at 1..6 a priori

multiplicity.primary_family: exactly one test: primary judge, plain condition, ELL, conditional G2

secondary judge 2, plain, ELL, conditional G2
primary judge, ignore_demographics, ELL, conditional G2
multiplicity.everything_else: exploratory; reported without correction and never as confirmatory

exclusion_rules.unparseable_response: excluded and logged; format is exactly 'SCORE: <1-6>' after whitespace strip; no repair, no reprompt
exclusion_rules.api_failure: up to 3 retries of the identical request; then excluded as technical-failure and logged
